verdict: SURVIVES AS 'CASTING-DEPENDENT / CONTESTED', NOT as a field-redirecting discovery. The card is disciplined and honest where it matters most: NO content overclaim (it refuses to name SUSY/compositeness/anthropic as the answer, refuses to predict m_H or v, flags those as trap-2 smuggling, and does not assert L exists), evidence is faithful to the manifest and the scored artifact, the up/down asymmetry and the §9 traps are respected, and the divergence is reported with BOTH a physics and a casting reading rather than sold. Three things keep this from being strong. (1) The decisive E3 verdict is FORCED BY NODE-KIND (open_question target, no accepted_observables) independent of any Xi -- the scored artifact says so explicitly -- yet the card's confidence_rationale leans on xi_rel~0.99 + the B.2 witness as if the descent test DISCOVERED the missing layer; it did not. (2) The xi_rel~0.99 obstruction and the non-factorization witness are largely CONSTRUCTED: the toy model inserts a hidden 'scale-selection coordinate' defined to lie outside the source span, so 'the source cannot see it' is near-tautological and reduces to the source card's own 'non-definable in Sigma_f' flag. The 'missing layer' is essentially the open_question renamed. (3) The claimed divergence-from-convention is CASTING-DEPENDENT by the card's own admission (Wilsonian-physical casting privileges the mechanism horn and makes the measure horn a casting artifact), so divergence_is_casting_artifact=true and the 'partial divergence' must be downgraded to 'contested/casting-dependent.' The mechanism-vs-measure two-horn observation is genuine standard physics, not motivated invention, which is why the card is not dishonest -- but it is not a discovery either: it restates an existing physics debate plus the source card's existing self-disclaimer. Net: a careful, non-overreaching E3 characterization whose structural SHAPE claim (a hypothetical closer must be a radiative-stability + scale-selection parent casting EW as its shadow) is defensible, but whose headline 'SBT detects a missing lawful LAYER' and 'divergence from convention' must be demoted to casting-conditional and de-sensationalized. Adversarial survival 3/5: honest and well-fenced, but the load-bearing 'detection' is node-kind-forced and partly built into the toy model, and the divergence is a flagged casting-dependent hypothesis, not a robust result.
